claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Pipamperone is a butyrophenone antipsychotic with no cytotoxic pharmacophore; at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive in a 5-day pooled viability screen, with any weak, non-selective antiproliferative effect attributable to off-target dopamine/serotonin/histamine receptor antagonism rather than a cytotoxic mechanism.
